    BEHIND THE PROTOTYPE
    Privacy depends on context.
    PrivacyLens explores a simple question: can choosing the recipient and purpose help students share useful screenshots with less unnecessary disclosure?
    Working in this version
    Correctable local document classification, document-specific purposes, context-dependent Hide / Keep / Review recommendations, preserved user choices and four pre-labelled examples, including technical diagnostics, local OCR, optional AI text classification, editable masks and flattened PNG export.
    Still to be evaluated
    Model accuracy, bounding-box precision, broader screenshot types and evaluation with students. Model suggestions need your review.
    课堂演示建议 / Demo guide
    选择图片或示例后自动在本机识别文字，再选择分享情境。高级设置保留语言与重扫选项；需要时再主动同意发送识别文字给 gpt-6-luna 分类，图片不发送。示例另有明确标注的预设区域。可组合选择公开平台、亲友、同学同事或官方客服，以及分享目的。文档类型可更正，用途随类型更新。建议包括遮挡、保留和待确认；待确认默认遮挡。用户修改独立保存，切换用途时保留；只有同图字段可靠匹配时才迁移旧选择，未匹配的遮挡保留并提示复核。二维码、条形码和人脸需手动补框。检查漏检后再导出。
    All sample personal details are fictional. Editing and OCR run on this device. AI text classification sends locally screened OCR text and layout; detected credentials are replaced but other personal text and missed credentials may remain. Text is sent through this site's server to its configured provider (default: ai.novacode.top), only with your consent. Images are not sent by this workflow. OCR models load from this site. Text and images are not stored by the app; model assets may be cached by your browser. This app does not save images or results; provider and hosting data policies apply. Suggestions do not guarantee that every sensitive detail is covered.
